product_metadata.title: Gootus Whiskey Glass Set of 2 - Scotch Bourbon Glasses for Men, Hand Blown Double Walled Old Fashioned Glass with Premium Gift Box
features: Double wall whiskey glass - The unique inner curve and angle allows your drink to aerate and swirled inside the glass. The outside wall will keep your whiskey cold until the last drop.
Craftsmanship - Gootus old fashioned Insulated whiskey glass tumbler are Hand-blown from special Lead-free Borosilicate glass. Lightweight double-walled unique design.

Unique technique and capacity - Concave rounded rim formed to fit the lower lip of the mouth elegantly. 6.7oz(200ml) capacity, its size and shape are perfected to accommodate a 35ml pour whilst allowing for the addition of water; keeping an optimum amount of liquid in contact with air to allow the aromas to develop.

Aroma focus - The shape, capacity, inner curve, and angle are precisely calculated and designed by talented designers, which focus the aromatics to the nose while simultaneously diffusing the ethanol away from the face, fantastically improving the taste of your whiskey.

Perfect gift - Set of 2 luxury glassware, perfect for Anniversary, Father's day, Birthday, Engagement, Wedding, Retirement Gag Gift, Christmas, to anyone who loves Whisky, Scotch, Bourbon and Old Fashioned Cocktails.
